item.description:
Automatic updates are now available in the website version of NotchCanvas.
• Check for updates in Settings → General → Software Update. • Automatic checks run daily. You choose when to install and restart. • Update downloads and the update feed are cryptographically signed. • Includes the latest notch layout, Settings, Reminders/Music Player switching, multi-display and About-screen fixes.
If you installed an older DMG without an updater, replace it once with this version. Your existing preferences and reminders remain in place.
